content.short: KuberIDE combines an IDE, api and infrastructure so that developers can write, test and deploy smart contract code seamlessly from within their browser.
content.description:
Productivity for existing and new developers to Cardano in writing, testing and deploying smart contracts.

Supports all Cardano networks and Web3 wallets conform CIP-95.

KuberIDE combines an IDE, api and infrastructure so that developers can write, test and deploy smart contract code seamlessly from within their browser.

KuberIDE is live since 02/2023 and available as installable component on Demeter.run amongst others used by IOHK education to onboard developers.

Kuber api is a replacement for the PAB available as open source since 06/2022, easily compose and balance transactions in Plutus/Haskell or JSON.

Extensive documentation and examples to get you started.

Frictionless onboarding developers on Cardano.
